title: Never Meant to Stay
author: Trisha Das
blurb: Well, a wedding photographer and the daughter of a diplomat, Samara Mansingh has never stayed in one place for too long. But life has other plans when she finds herself thrown into the chaos of the Khanna household and crosses paths with a not-so-heartthrob, Sharav Khanna. Join Samara as she sprinkles a little magic into the lives of the Khannas and, in return, discovers what it truly means to find a home.
